description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest data transfer object (DTO) within the Leave module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests various scenarios such as empty leave requests, single-day requests, multi-day requests with holidays, and leave periods. The class includes setup procedures, mock service configurations, and multiple test methods to ensure correct behavior of the DTO.
published: OrangeHRM	ests\'s\' Entity classes and test utilities

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the DetailedLeaveRequest DTO, including handling of various leave request scenarios such as empty requests, single-day, multi-day, and leave periods, using mock services and fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by populating test data from a YAML configuration file before each test case.

methods.name: testEmptyLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior of DetailedLeaveRequest when instantiated with an empty LeaveRequest object, ensuring proper error handling when accessing uninitialized properties and setting leaves.

methods.name: testSingleDayLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests retrieval and details of a single-day leave request.

methods.name: testMultiDayLeaveRequestFirstDayHoliday
methods.description: Tests handling of a multi-day leave request where the first day is a holiday.

methods.name: testMultiStatusLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests a leave request with multiple statuses, verifying allowed actions.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Configures mock services and dependencies required for the test cases, including a mock authenticated user.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodsWithAssignedLeaveForPastLeavePeriod
methods.description: Verifies that leave periods are correctly fetched and handled for past leave periods, applying mocked current date.
